name: QR_Rule_09: Removable USB Storage Device Connected
description: Detects attachment or installation of removable USB storage devices through Windows device and driver events.
gpo_policy: Removable USB storage must be blocked or restricted; each attachment must be reviewed.
expression: SELECT username, "Computer", "ClassName", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('6416','2003','2102') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: Event ID is any of 6416, 2003, or 2102, optionally restricted to DiskDrive or USB device classes. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by Computer.
